thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up: TidalEdge Labs is doing an APAC pilot demo tomorrow 09:00 SGT and are hitting rate limits in staging. They asked for a short 72h throughput bump + CIDR allowlist so their demo scripts don't fail. Renewal conversation in two weeks — if this flops it's a big risk.

jack_infra: Got it. Can you share exact IPs/CIDRs + the rate window you want? Also which region to pin (asia-southeast-1 / ap-south-1 / ap-northeast-1)?

maria_cs: Thanks. Owner is sara@tidaledge.com. Requested window: 2026-03-25T01:00Z -> 2026-03-28T01:00Z (72h). Target peak qps ~2800, sustained 1500. IPs they said the scripts will run from: 34.75.12.0/24 and 13.250.0.0/16. Region: asia-southeast-1 preferred.

jack_infra: That QPS is high for a short bump but doable with dedicated burst pool. I'll need an ops ticket to reserve burst capacity and a quick canary route. Sophie, can you coordinate pre-warming KV cache + increasing concurrent worker limit on the inference pool?

sophie_se: On it. I can pre-warm KV cache for the demo models, set batch_max_tokens=512 and concurrency to 24. Will also create a canary route pointing to a warmed model variant.

ops-bot: @jack_infra created ticket OPS-6218: "TidalEdge APAC demo temporary burst + CIDR allowlist". SLA: approve within 2hrs for emergency bursts. Link: https://redwood.ops/OPS-6218

jack_infra: I need the exact model slug they will hit so I can pin capacity. maria_cs, which model are they using?

maria_cs: They're on "tidal-demo-1" which maps to redwood/gpt-medium-v1 in staging. Also asked to enable prefix caching for repeated prompts.

jack_infra: Ok reserving burst pool in asia-southeast-1, will add CIDRs to proxy allowlist, and create a canary with prefix caching enabled. I'll update OPS-6218 with changes and estimated cost uplift.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: canary/redwood-gpt-medium-v1-warmed -> asia-southeast-1. ETA ~18m.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Please ping me in this thread when done so I can confirm with Sara and run the final demo smoke test. Also flag if any cost/renewal talking points we should cover with the AE.

jack_infra: Update in OPS-6218: 72h burst provisioned, CIDR 34.75.12.0/24 and 13.250.0.0/16 added to allowlist, region pin asia-southeast-1, concurrency raised, prefix caching enabled. Estimated cost uplift ~ $1.2k for 72h.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll tell the AE to surface demo success as a renewal momentum point. Sara will run smoke at 08:30 SGT and start main demo at 09:00.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed successfully to asia-southeast-1. Logs: ``INFO warmup complete; kv_cache_hits=98%``

jack_infra: Closing loop — OPS-6218 marked "done". We'll auto-revoke burst and remove CIDRs at 2026-03-28T01:05Z unless you request extension.

maria_cs: Closing: confirmed with customer, demo succeeded, AE notified. Revoke time noted. :tada:
